title: ADA Subject — one column of a tabular component
description: One item of a `columns` array. Measured across the 49 inferred schemas that carry `columns`: 14 distinct item shapes, every one a SUBSET of the nine keys below, with colNum and fieldDescription present in all 14. So this is one shape with optional keys, not fourteen shapes — verified by set containment, not assumed.

colNum.description: 1-based position of the column in the file. Integer in all 49 schemas, with no variants. Maps to cdif:index.

fieldType.description: Physical data type as ADA records it. Maps to cdif:physicalDataType.
